### A City Offered Up to God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/city-offered-god
Passage: Deuteronomy 13:12-18
Points:
- The total destruction prescribed for apostate cities illustrates God's righteous judgment through burnt offering imagery.
- Accusations of idolatry could not be handled rashly and required thorough, diligent investigation.
- Burning all plunder prevented people from bringing false charges to seize personal wealth.
- The command demonstrates how seriously God regards covenant unfaithfulness and false worship.
- While the church wields no physical sword today, Christians should pray for idolaters to receive Christ and escape divine wrath.
